verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents a broad, API-first REST surface covering Pix charges and transfers, Boletos, card acquiring, splits, corporate cards and holders, DICT keys, payment previews, verified accounts and webhooks. It also publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, a Postman collection and SDKs in ten languages, so most core banking operations are scriptable. However, nothing states API/UI parity. Some UI-marketed features (CDI yield investments, digital-asset trading, card-machine receivables) have no API evidence, and payment approval is explicitly routed to the Web Banking UI. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API evidence for investments, crypto trading and receivables, API-side approval flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
